title: Convergent Invoicing: Basic Data
raw_text:

Convergent Invoicing: Basic Data
e The invoicing category for finer control of billing and

invoicing processes

e The selection characteristic in scheduling that is used for
contract-account-dependent derivation of rating, billing
and invoicing dates

e That no invoice is created or processing is blocked as a
result of specifying a lock reason for a master data record

e The target currency for posting of amounts in invoicing

e That a key is entered for determining forms at the contract
account level

This key is used in determining an alternative application

form.
Convergent Invoicing: Periodic Bills                                            When the system generates periodic bills
Convergent Invoicing: Individual Charges/Discounts                       The individual charges and discounts you calculate for the business

partner

In addition, industry-specific fields are also available.

Link: Contract Account - Business Partner

Use

At least one business partner is assigned to each contract account. Depending on the industry sector, assignment of several
business partners to a contract account is also allowed.

Prerequisites

Additional business partners can only be assigned to a contract account if the corresponding contract account category allows
this.

Features

The master data for a contract account is divided into a part that is the same for all business partners of the contract account
(that is, independent of the business partner) and a part that is business-partner-specific. The business partner-specific data can
be controlled differently for different business partners.

Activities

In Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under |}Basic Functions » Contract Accounts » Contract Account
Relationships » Define Contract Account/Business Partner Relationships ™, you define contract account relationships.
